entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: Humanoid beings made of aether who spontaneously appear on Avishkar, with short, joyful lives.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where aetherborn came into being.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: Aetherborn investor, philanthropist, socialite and renegade.

events.summary: Aetherborn spontaneously come into being on Avishkar as a byproduct of aether refinement, and inventors initially persecute them as mistakes.
events.quote: Initially, inventors persecuted the earliest Aetherborn, seeing them as "mistakes".

relations.quote: Yahenni , an investor, philanthropist, socialite, and renegade.
